pages.text: $(italic)Still pinned to the board outside the store. Rain has taken the bottom third. The nail is rusted through and it has not fallen down anyway.$()
pages.title: Found on the bounty board

pages.text: WANTED -- ANY HANDS$(br)Little Kettle Valley. Spring. Dry work and wet.$(br)Board and meals at the inn.$(br)Pay negotiable and honest.$(br)Ask for J. Kettle, the farm on the rise.
$(italic)Underneath, in a second hand -- Oda's, much smaller:$()$(br2)posted yr 11, spring$(br)no replies$(br)left up$(br2)$(italic)Oda has replaced the nail twice.$()
